To get the position of the first and last instance of a character in a text string, you can use the `find()` and `rfind()` methods in Python. 

Here's an example:

```python
text = "Hello, World!"
char = "o"

first_position = text.find(char)
last_position = text.rfind(char)

print(f"The first position of '{char}' is: {first_position}")
print(f"The last position of '{char}' is: {last_position}")
```

In this example, `find()` returns the index of the first occurrence of the character in the string, and `rfind()` returns the index of the last occurrence. If the character is not found, both methods return -1.
